moves.speaker: Craig Evans
moves.excerpt: but again i contest with my last minute uh the last supper referred to in first corinthians 11 is earth bound it is a historical reference paul begins the passage by saying on the night jesus was betrayed he took bread this is not in outer space this is here on the night he was betrayed no he doesn't then give us the entire gospel passage but he's alluding to and it's very close in wording to what you actually have in luke the night he was betrayed he took bread and this is what he said so now when we do that we're doing it in remembrance of him and he goes on to exhort the corinthians on how they ought to behave

responseComponents.text: Paul places the Last Supper on the night Jesus was betrayed, making the episode an earthbound historical reference.

moves.excerpt: and one last point irenaeus in the late second century is responding not to paul but to the way paul and john i might add have been exploited by gnostics who want to do uh what richard carriers has all along been saying that early christians were doing the gnostics wanted to turn jesus into a cosmic celestial being and that's what irenaeus is opposing not paul

responseComponents.text: Irenaeus opposed later Gnostic exploitation of Paul and John rather than an originally celestial Pauline Jesus.
